scope.text: Water Research publishes original research on the science and technology of the anthropogenic water cycle, water quality, and water management worldwide. Its applied interdisciplinary remit covers treatment and recovery, urban hydrology, drinking water, reuse, sanitation and public health, contaminants and water quality, anthropogenic impacts and restoration, water interfaces, water-related modelling and machine learning, and socio-economic, policy, and regulatory studies. Work centred on a supporting discipline can be rejected upfront when it does not make a strong connection to water research.

official_excerpts.text: all aspects of the science and technology of the anthropogenic water cycle, water quality, and its management worldwide.

inclusions: Water and wastewater treatment, resource recovery, and residual management
Urban hydrology, sewer systems, stormwater, and green infrastructure
Drinking water, distribution, reuse, sanitation, public health, and risk assessment
Water contaminants, sensing, monitoring, fate, assessment, and anthropogenic impacts
Restoration and remediation linked to surface water or groundwater
Water-sediment and water-atmosphere interfaces under anthropogenic influence
Mathematical modelling, systems analysis, machine learning, and beneficial big-data use related to the anthropogenic water cycle
Water-related socio-economic, policy, and regulation research
official_exclusions_or_boundaries: Work that goes deeply into chemistry, toxicology, microbiology, materials science, or another supporting discipline without a good link to water research

official_excerpts.text: Water Research publishes refereed, original research papers

submission_notes: The official journal description directly verifies refereed original research papers.
No additional genre is enabled in this registry until its current rule is captured from the journal-specific official Guide for Authors.
